usedFor: Raisely holds fundraising campaigns, and Google Sheets logs gifts with “Add New Row to Sheet” after “New Online Donation”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Online Donation” in Raisely, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each online donation becomes a row, so the team tracks giving in a sheet.

watchOut: “New Online Donation” covers online gifts only, so gifts recorded another way will not add a row.
